claim: Rufford Old Hall (NT) opens house 11:00–16:30 and garden/tea-room 10:30–16:30 on a typical late-May Saturday; adult admission £13.00.
quote: House: 11:00 AM - 4:30 PM; Garden: 10:30 AM - 4:30 PM; Tea-room: 10:30 AM - 4:30 PM. Adult (18+): £13.00 without Gift Aid

claim: Rufford Old Hall's Tudor Great Hall houses a carved oak screen surviving from the 1500s, plus tapestries, arms and armour, with gardens and canal-side woodland walks.
quote: Tudor Great Hall: Features fantastic furniture, arms, armour, tapestries and the carved oak screen, a rare survivor from the 1500s

claim: Speke Hall's Tudor mansion is closed on Saturdays in 2026; only the gardens (10:00–17:00) and restaurant (10:00–16:30) are open Saturday, so it is a grounds-only pick on a Moor-Hall dinner day.
quote: Saturday Opening Hours: Gardens 10:00 - 17:00, while Hall is Closed. The restaurant serves from 10:00 - 16:30.

claim: Speke Hall is a rare Tudor timber-framed manor with a priest hole, William Morris wallpaper, hedge maze and bluebell woodland; grounds adult ticket £13, house+grounds £18.
quote: a rare Tudor timber-framed manor house ... priest hole, Gothic Revival furnishings, and William Morris wallpaper inside ... a mind-boggling hedge maze. Grounds adult £13.00, Combined house and grounds £18.00

claim: Meols Hall (Churchtown, Southport) opens to the public only on May Bank Holiday Mondays and late-August through 25 September daily 13:30–17:30 — so it is NOT visitable on a typical Saturday.
quote: open to the public on May Bank Holiday Mondays: 4th & 25th and August Bank Holiday Monday 31st August until Friday 25th September daily, 1.30pm until 5.30pm

claim: Croxteth Hall and Walled Garden open daily 10:30–17:00 from 24 March to 30 September; the surrounding country park stays open 07:00–19:00 in summer — easy mid-afternoon stop before driving back to Aughton.
quote: Hall & Walled Garden: 24th March - 30th September: Monday to Sunday 10:30 - 17:00. Country Park: 1st April - 31st October: Monday to Sunday 07:00 - 19:00

claim: Astley Hall in Chorley reopens 5 April 2026 with free entry while West Wing restoration continues; only east-wing ground-floor rooms accessible until late July 2026, after which opening expands Tuesday–Sunday.
quote: Astley Hall Museum will be open for free visits from Sunday 5 April 2026 until late July 2026, alongside the ongoing West Wing restoration works

claim: Hoghton Tower offers self-guided Saturday house and garden access 11:00–16:00 (last entry 15:30) from 4 April to 3 October 2026 — workable but borderline 30 km and several Saturdays are closed for events.
quote: Self-Guided House Visits are available on Saturdays from April 4th to October 3rd, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM (last entry at 3:30 PM)

claim: Sefton Park Palm House (Liverpool) is a free Victorian glasshouse open daily 10:30–18:30 in summer — a long-window, low-commitment heritage stop that easily fits before a 19:00 Moor Hall slot.
quote: The Palm House is open from April 1st to October 31st from 10:30 am to 6:30 pm ... Admission to the Palm House and Sefton Park is free.

claim: Scarisbrick Hall (Pugin Gothic Revival, A570 between Ormskirk and Southport) is a school today and only opens for two booked public days in 2026 — 20 August and 23 October — so it is not a generic Saturday option.
quote: Open days are scheduled to be held on 20 August and 23 October, with booking required.

claim: Burscough Priory is an Augustinian ruin founded c.1190, dissolved 1536; only two crossing piers and chancel-wall stumps remain, freely accessible as a Scheduled Ancient Monument — a 15-minute drive-by stop, not a half-day.
quote: The remains consist of the two piers at the junction of the north transept and the crossing ... It is a Scheduled Ancient Monument ... Entry is often free for general exploration of the ruins.

claim: Lytham Hall (Georgian, Fylde coast) opens parkland daily 10:00–16:30 and the Georgian Hall 12:00–16:00 (last entry 15:00); pay on the door — sits at the outer edge of the 30 km radius.
quote: Parkland is open daily from 10:00am to 4:30pm ... Georgian Hall is open daily from 12:00pm to 4:00pm (last entry 3:00pm) ... Pre booking is not required - just pay on the door.

claim: Walker Art Gallery in Liverpool city centre opens Saturday 10:00–17:00 with free admission — a strong wet-weather plan B inside the 30 km radius.
quote: open on Saturdays from 10 am–5 pm. Admission is free to the Gallery and to all exhibitions and events.
